direct-admission.note: Actual idle-host durable receipt admission/claim, existing owner native dispatch/confirmation and receipt result; terminal excluded

duplicate-read.note: 100 matching durable submissions and receipt reads; no dispatch

native-completion.note: Native terminal owner outcome and durable receipt completion; no per-item writes

queued-admission.note: Actual durable receipt admission/claim, owner job acceptance and queued receipt result; setup excluded

queued-cancellation.note: Existing durable owner cancellation and receipt terminal boundary

queued-dispatch.note: Prior owner terminal plus queued native dispatch/confirmation and durable receipt started boundary; initial admission excluded

shutdown-uncertain.note: Graceful shutdown settles one active plus one queued owner job and its queued receipt without replay

uncertain-retries.note: 100 reads and retries of stopped uncertain acceptance; no dispatch or prompt restoration
